osaka_jinrui_mina_menrui_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in a soy-sauce broth; gyoza.
osaka_jinrui_mina_menrui_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a shellfish and bonito broth with pork chashu.
osaka_jinrui_mina_menrui_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 10:00–03:00; Fri 10:00–04:00; Sat 9:00–04:00; Sun 9:00–03:00 (Tabelog). In October 2026 the shop was under renovation, done by the staff, and was running from a temporary shop about a minute's walk away; the work was expected to finish around December 2026 or later (October 2026). Lines most of the day: about 10 people at 11:00 and around 23:00, more than 20 after 22:30, few at 1:00–3:00 (October 2026). No reservations; Tabelog lists no cards, e-money or QR. Order by QR code through LINE (October 2026). 26 seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 12 April 2012 (Tabelog).
osaka_jinrui_mina_menrui_nishinakajima.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima, the queue-famous shellfish-soy ramen by Minamikata] The original shop of an Osaka group, open since 2012 and in the Tabelog Ramen 100 every year from 2017 to 2025, with lines from late morning to late night (October 2026). The broth is soy sauce over clams and bonito, with a gentle sweetness that some love and some find too mild; the Macro, finished with light soy, is the clam-forward bowl, and the Genten the richer one (October 2026). Get the thick-cut chashu: slabs that fall apart, ¥1,400 with egg (October 2026). Mr. Children plays in the shop. In late 2026 the shop is being renovated and runs from a temporary site a minute away (October 2026).

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog beyond access; opened 12 April 2012; Tabelog Ramen WEST 100 2017–2022 and Ramen OSAKA 100 2023–2025 (Tabelog). Operator site unchi-co.com (Tabelog). The staff play Mr. Children live recordings (October–November 2026) and were doing the renovation in-house in October 2026; a café-bar a minute away gives half off with a same-day ramen receipt (October 2026).

anecdotes.text: "This is the most popular clam-based ramen. It captures the umami of clams like asari and shijimi, finished lightly with a light soy sauce." — October 2026, Macro with sliced chashu for JPY 950.
"I didn't want to wait in line, so I visited at 3 AM." — October 2026, Ramen Genten at the temporary shop.
"The broth is said to be made with shellfish stock, but it doesn't have a strong shellfish flavor." — November 2026, Macro with thick chashu and egg.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 人類みな麺類、ラーメン、ラーメン WEST 百名店 2017〜2022、ラーメン OSAKA 百名店 2023〜2025、大阪市淀川区西中島1-12-15、阪急 南方駅から徒歩0分、西中島南方駅から徒歩1分、月〜木10:00〜翌3:00、金10:00〜翌4:00、土9:00〜翌4:00、日曜9:00〜翌3:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、26席、禁煙、子ども可、2012年4月12日オープン、運営 unchi-co.com。口コミ (2026年10〜11月): 改装中で1分ほどの仮店舗で営業、改装はスタッフが自分たちで、12月か来年に終わる予定、行列 (朝11時に約10人、夜22時半すぎに20人以上)、注文は LINE の QR、Mr.Children が流れる、あさりとしじみの貝と鰹節のだしの醤油ラーメン、やさしい甘み、「原点」は濃いめの醤油、「Macro」は薄口醤油で貝が前に、太めのストレート麺、厚切りチャーシューはとろとろ、薄切りも、半熟卵、太いメンマ、Macro の薄切りチャーシュー950円、厚切りチャーシューと卵1,400円がいちばん人気、替え玉、餃子、近くのカフェバーはレシートで半額、甘みが合わないという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue outside, then order by QR code through LINE. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated November 2026. Operating from a temporary shop about a minute away during renovation (October 2026); the pin is the listed address.

osaka_shofuku_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thick wheat noodles in a soy-seasoned pork broth.
osaka_shofuku_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork broth, pork slices, back fat and katsuobushi.
osaka_shofuku_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–24:00, until sold out; open all year; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; Tabelog lists no cards, e-money or QR. Ticket machine, where the free extras are set too (2026). 12 counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 30 November 2009 (Tabelog).
osaka_shofuku_nishinakajima.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima, Jiro-style ramen with a heap of katsuobushi] A 12-seat counter by Minamikata, open since 2009, serving Jiro-style ramen: thick, firm noodles under a mound of bean sprouts and pork, with katsuobushi on top that adds a fishy punch you won't find at most Jiro-style shops (2026). Set your noodles, vegetables, garlic, back fat and bonito at the ticket machine; the regular bowl, 200 g of noodles and two slices of pork, is ¥950 (2026). Regulars say the taste and portion can depend on who is cooking (June 2026). Open daily to midnight, until sold out.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 30 November 2009 (Tabelog). A June 2026 diner: "The cheerful lady and the energetic gentleman manage the place well", adding that taste and portion can change with who is cooking. Web search (2026-11-02) found a Shofuku in Umeda (Osaka Ekimae Dai-3 Building B2, January 2024 article); a Nishi-Honmachi shop is listed as closed on Retty.

anecdotes.text: "At JPY 950, I think the cost performance is quite reasonable in this day and age." — June 2026, regular ramen, 200 g noodles.
"I had the experience of trying Jiro-style ramen with bonito flakes for the first time. It surprisingly paired well and was delicious!" — August 2026, pork ramen for JPY 1,200.
"There was an incredible amount of bean sprouts—just bean sprouts everywhere!" — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラーメンつけ麺 笑福 大阪西中島店、ラーメン・つけ麺、大阪市淀川区西中島1-13-13 三信南方ビルII 1F、南方駅と西中島南方駅から徒歩1分、毎日11:00〜24:00 (売り切れまで)、無休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター12席、禁煙、子ども可、2009年11月30日オープン。口コミ (2026年5〜10月): 二郎系、麺、野菜、にんにく、脂、かつお節の量を選べる、券売機でトッピングも、ラーメン (麺200g、豚2枚) 950円、豚ラーメン1,200円、味噌ラーメン、麺少なめで半熟卵、野菜はほぼもやし、かつお節のせはめずらしい、「Katsuo Baka Mashi」は2026年9月までになくなった、作る人で味と量が変わるという声、水は大きなジョッキで。

osaka_semba_kitchen_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Pasta, pizza and the fried chicken are wheat-based; charcoal-grilled meats, rotisserie chicken, carpaccio and ajillo are where to ask.
osaka_semba_kitchen_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: grilled beef and chicken, seafood, anchovy potato salad and cheese pastas.
osaka_semba_kitchen_minamisenba.hours_raw: Sun–Thu and holidays 15:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 15:00–24:00 (last orders 23:00 and 23:30) (Tabelog). A ¥330 table charge (Tabelog). Courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥4,000 (Tabelog); a ¥2,500 share course (October 2026). Order by QR code (October 2026). Reservations; a booking may be released 15 minutes after the time without contact (Tabelog); one diner was told a time limit only after ordering (May 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 80 seats with a counter and an open kitchen, standing parties to 90; open terrace; non-smoking; outlets; English and digital menus; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Opened 15 September 2010 (Tabelog).
osaka_semba_kitchen_minamisenba.notes: [Italian · Minami-Senba, a big charcoal-grill bistro] A spacious, lively Italian bistro in Minami-Senba with an open kitchen, a terrace and some 80 seats, open from 15:00. It is a place for sharing: anchovy potato salad and carpaccio, trippa, rotisserie and charcoal-grilled meats such as Tokachi beef, and fresh Awaji pasta like corn cacio e pepe, with plenty of wine. A ¥2,500 share course is good value, an October 2026 diner says. Reviews are split: many found it a pleasant surprise, while others in 2026 reported tough steak, mushy pasta, a broken chair, a seat by the restroom or brusque glass-clearing. Open late at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "Namba-Semba Food Landmark", a popular charcoal-grilled Italian in Minami-Senba with 80 seats and over 80 dishes; opened 15 September 2010. A Green House branch at Herbis Plaza is listed on Gnavi.
chef_bio.philosophy: A menu you will not tire of even if you come every day (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "What truly impressed me was the 'Corn Cacio e Pepe' made with fresh pasta from Awaji Seimen!" — October 2026, the ¥2,500 share course.
"I ordered the Hokkaido beef strip loin, which looked delicious in the photos, but I found it to be a bit tough when I actually ate it." — June 2026.
"The all-you-can-drink option was available, but the glass exchange felt a bit aggressive" — September 2026.

osaka_oden_soba_jinbee_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The oden broth tastes strongly of soy sauce (October 2026) and the fish cakes are homemade, not described; soba, fu, gyoza in broth, tempura and chicken nanban contain wheat. Sashimi is the plainest choice.
osaka_oden_soba_jinbee_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in an Osaka-style dashi, homemade fish cakes, sashimi and chicken.
osaka_oden_soba_jinbee_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); Sat 12:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); Sun 12:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); irregular closures (Tabelog). Happy hour, including weekends (October–November 2026). A ¥330 appetizer charge (Tabelog). Reservations; course cancellations by the day before; two hours when busy (Tabelog). A ¥5,000 course of ten dishes with 90-minute all-you-can-drink (Tabelog). Order by QR code (August 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 69 seats: a counter round the oden pot and tables downstairs, tatami and tables upstairs (up to 40, private for 35+); non-smoking, ashtray outside; takeaway (Tabelog).
osaka_oden_soba_jinbee_namba.notes: [Oden · Namba Sennichimae, oden, wholesaler sashimi and soba] A busy oden izakaya near Nippombashi that shares the Jinbee name and the wholesaler Uoya Ebizo with Sakana no Jinbee (Tabelog), with a counter round the simmering oden pot downstairs and tatami upstairs. Order oden by the piece, homemade fish cakes, daikon, chicken wings falling off the bone, even gyoza in broth, with sashimi from that wholesaler, then finish with soba. Regulars love a dashi-wari, sake or shochu cut with the oden broth. Diners in 2026 praise the broth, the value and the happy hour; one found the broth strongly soy-flavored. Book ahead in the evening; open from noon at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: sashimi delivered daily from the partner wholesaler Uoya Ebizo, homemade nerimono oden in an Osaka-style dashi and soba to finish; a lively counter round the oden pot downstairs; rare Miyazaki shochu. An August 2026 diner writes: "This Jinbee is different from the others!"

anecdotes.text: "I noticed they had a sake with dashi on the drink menu, so I ordered that at the end! It was also very tasty, so I highly recommend it." — August 2026, after oden and meat soba.
"Gyoza in Oden Broth: Isn't it rare to have gyoza in oden broth?" — September 2026, finishing with hanamaki soba.
"The oden had a strong soy sauce flavor." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): おでんとお蕎麦居酒屋 じんべえ 難波店、居酒屋・おでん・そば、難波千日前1-8、Namba 駅から徒歩5分、月〜金 17:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、土 12:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、日 12:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、お通し330円、予約可、コースのキャンセルは前日まで、混雑時は2時間、90分飲み放題つきの10品のコース5,000円、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、69席 (1階はおでん鍋を囲むカウンターとテーブル、2階は座敷とテーブル、40名まで)、禁煙 (屋外に灰皿)、テイクアウト、自社の卸 Uoya Ebizo から直送の刺身、自家製の練り物のおでんと大阪のお出汁、締めの蕎麦、宮崎の珍しい焼酎。口コミ(2026年8月〜11月): おでん (大根、ちくわ、がんもどき、厚揚げ、卵、手羽先、鶏皮、餅)、おでん出汁の餃子、刺身5種盛り、鰹のたたき、チキン南蛮、せせりのねぎ焼き、自家製の赤柚子胡椒天、出汁割り、蕎麦湯割り、もり蕎麦、花巻蕎麦、肉蕎麦、QR で注文、ハッピーアワー、醤油の味が強いという声も。

osaka_ramuya_sennichimae.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Plain grilled lamb is where to start; the dipping sauce, tsukemen, lamb curry and sausage are not described.
osaka_ramuya_sennichimae.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a lamb restaurant; the vegetables are grilled in lamb fat on the jingisukan pan (May 2026).
osaka_ramuya_sennichimae.hours_raw: Weekdays 17:00–05:00; weekends and holidays 11:00–05:00; open all year (Tabelog). Reservations; online table bookings may be seated at the counter (Tabelog). No service or table charge (Tabelog). Courses ¥4,580 and ¥6,280 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 25 seats: 4 at the counter, 21 at tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog; May–June 2026); wheelchair accessible; outlets (Tabelog). Your clothes will smell of lamb (March 2026). Opened 14 February 2017 (Tabelog).
osaka_ramuya_sennichimae.notes: [Jingisukan · Sennichimae, fresh lamb until 5 am] A small second-floor jingisukan restaurant on a back street near Nippombashi, open until 5:00 every day, serving chilled, never-frozen lamb that even first-timers find mild. Grill the chuck eye roll and leg on the jingisukan pan, let the fat drip onto the bean sprouts and chives, then add the popular lamb chops, rarer cuts like tongue, heart and liver, and finish with tsukemen in the lamb broth or the lamb curry. The staff explain cuts and cooking. Diners in 2026 call it their favorite lamb; some found the lamb chops or mutton less impressive, and smoking is allowed inside.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a fresh-lamb specialist using only the freshest lamb, with lamb chops as the most popular dish and limited lamb breast, tongue and heart; open until 5:00; opened 14 February 2017. 2026 reviews: the meat is chilled, never frozen, and staff advise searing it lightly.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh, mild lamb for first-timers and those who usually avoid it (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "They mentioned that the meat is chilled and not frozen, and that it should be lightly seared with a slightly rare center." — September 2026.
"The surrounding vegetables are incredibly delicious as well, so I recommend letting the lamb fat drip onto them for an even better taste." — May 2026, a second visit.
"To be honest, the recommended lamb chops didn't impress me that much." — April 2026, who loved the lamb curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 生ラム肉専門店 らむ屋、ジンギスカン、千日前1-6-1 山喜登会館 2F、Kintetsu Nippombashi 駅から徒歩3分、平日17:00〜5:00、土日祝11:00〜5:00、年中無休、予約可 (ネット予約のテーブル席がカウンターになることも)、サービス料・チャージなし、カード・電子マネー・QR可、25席 (カウンター4、テーブル21)、喫煙可、車椅子可、電源、2017年2月14日オープン、新鮮な生ラム、一番人気のラムチョップ、ラムの胸肉・タン・ハツは数量限定、カジュアルコース4,580円、ジンギスカン満喫コース6,280円、北海道限定の Sapporo Classic。口コミ(2026年3月〜9月): ラムチョップ、肩ロース、もも、マトンロース、ネック、カルビ、タン、レバー、ハツ、ソーセージ、ラムカレー、締めのつけ麺、冷蔵で冷凍しない肉、臭みがない、喫煙可が気になるという声、服ににおいがつく。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain cuts and cooking (June and September 2026); many overseas guests (May 2026). No English menu evidence found.

osaka_takoyaki_oden_ishibashi_kitahorie.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki is a wheat batter. The clam-dashi oden is not described for gluten; fish cakes such as chikuwa and maruten often contain wheat, so ask.
osaka_takoyaki_oden_ishibashi_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: everything is made with clam (asari) dashi (Tabelog).
osaka_takoyaki_oden_ishibashi_kitahorie.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–04:00 (last order 03:00); open all year (Tabelog). A ¥418 appetizer charge, quail eggs in July–August 2026 (Tabelog; 2026). Reservations; no same-day online changes; a booking is released 15 minutes after the time without notice (Tabelog). Courses with all-you-can-drink ¥4,700–¥5,000; parties to 40 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats: a counter of 4, tables, a tatami area and a loft for 2–8; open terrace; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi; sports viewing (Tabelog). Opened 10 October 2013 (Tabelog); formerly 蛸焼とおでん くれ屋 (Tabelog).
osaka_takoyaki_oden_ishibashi_kitahorie.notes: [Oden · Yotsubashi, clam-dashi oden and takoyaki until 4 am] A small, lantern-lit izakaya steps from Yotsubashi Station where everything starts from clam (asari) dashi: homemade fish-cake oden in a gentle clam broth with the clams themselves, and takoyaki with that broth in the batter, eaten with sauce, salt, or dipped Akashi-yaki style. Add sashimi, sea grapes and an Osaka gari chuhai. It stays open until 4:00 every night, so it fills with second and third stops. Diners in 2026 praise the broth and the takoyaki; one found the oden under-soaked and the appetizer charge high. Smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a clam-dashi specialist whose asari dashi is used in every dish; all the oden fish cakes are homemade; open until 4:00; opened 10 October 2013; former name 蛸焼とおでん くれ屋.

anecdotes.text: "What sets their takoyaki apart is that they use asari (small clam) dashi in the batter." — July 2026, a solo third stop, takoyaki with sauce ¥528.
"The clams are a standout ingredient, adding a nice touch." — August 2026, ordering both the eight- and five-piece oden.
"The daikon wasn't soaked enough, and the maruten and chikuwa were hardly infused at all. However, the beef tendon was delicious." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): たこ焼きとおでん 石橋 (旧店名 蛸焼とおでん くれ屋)、おでん・たこ焼き・居酒屋、西区北堀江1-1-3 四ツ橋日生ビル別館 1F、Yotsubashi 駅3番出口から徒歩8秒、毎日17:00〜4:00 (L.O.3:00)、年中無休、お通し418円、予約可、飲み放題つきのコース4,700〜5,000円、40名まで、カード・PayPay可、30席 (カウンター4、テーブル、座敷、2〜8名のロフト)、テラス、喫煙可、無料Wi-Fi、2013年10月10日オープン、浅利出汁をすべての料理に、自家製の練り物のおでん。口コミ(2026年6月〜9月): あさり出汁のおでん5種・8種盛り、あさり、たこ焼き (ソース528円、塩、出汁だこ)、刺身、海ぶどう、うずらの卵440円、生ビール660円、ガリチューハイ、夏酒、メガジョッキ、出汁のしみが浅いという声も。

osaka_naniwa_ryori_gotoku.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Lunch trays include tempura and kakiage, marinated tuna and miso soup; dinner is creative Japanese with dashi and soy seasoning.
osaka_naniwa_ryori_gotoku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, tempura, dashi-based dishes.
osaka_naniwa_ryori_gotoku.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:45) and 17:45–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Sundays and some holidays; closing times may vary (Tabelog). A June 2025 diner wrote that the shop stays open until 2:30 am; Tabelog gives 22:00. Lunch may end early once the last regulars leave (June 2025). Cash only: no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 17 seats: 6 at the counter, two tables for 4 and three semi-private sunken-seat rooms; non-smoking (Tabelog). About 20 sakes; menus can be tailored if booked ahead (Tabelog).
osaka_naniwa_ryori_gotoku.notes: [Japanese · Fukushima, tray lunches and sake by night] A seventeen-seat kappo near JR Fukushima, run by a father and son, the chef having trained for years at Japanese restaurants in Nishitenma (June 2025). Lunch is the local secret: a ¥1,000 or ¥1,300 tray of small dishes, marinated tuna, freshly fried kakiage eaten with salt, tamagoyaki, grilled fish and a miso soup scented with sansho, with rice refills and a dessert, at prices unchanged for years. By night it turns to creative washoku and about twenty sakes, like thick Kochi katsuo tataki or hamo fried with ginger. Cash only; lunch fills up; closed Sundays.

roles: Chef (unnamed) and the chef's father or son (June 2025)
chef_bio.background: A June 2025 diner: "The restaurant is run by a father-son duo, with the chef having years of experience in washoku establishments in Nishitenma." Shop text (Tabelog): seasonal dishes in a warm atmosphere; authentic creative Japanese cuisine with daily specials, omakase courses and two lunch menus; menus tailored on advance booking; about 20 sakes.

anecdotes.text: "The tempura was served hot and fresh, seasoned with salt instead of dipping sauce, and the kakiage was crispy and delicious." — September 2025, a visitor to the Osaka Expo.
"The miso soup is delicious with a hint of sansho pepper." — May 2026.
"You can also opt for a large serving of rice, and the prices have remained unchanged for many years." — April 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Warm hospitality from the chef (June 2025). No English evidence found.

osaka_tori_kappou_naraya.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses include soba, chawanmushi, chicken broth soup, clay-pot rice and tare skewers; write allergies in the booking request (Tabelog).
osaka_tori_kappou_naraya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and duck kappo; cabbage skewers à la carte.
osaka_tori_kappou_naraya.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–23:30 (last order 22:30); closed Sundays, holidays, New Year, Obon and Golden Week; seating may be limited to about 2.5 hours and the shop may close around 23:00 (Tabelog). Courses need advance booking; write allergies or dislikes in the request; private rooms by phone; phones may go unanswered after 17:00 when busy (Tabelog). Service charge 3% (Tabelog). No minors (Tabelog). Opened October 29, 2018 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 at the counter, a table for 4, private rooms for 6–8; heated tobacco only, in a designated area (Tabelog).
osaka_tori_kappou_naraya.notes: [Yakitori · Kitashinchi, Nara chicken kappo] A twenty-seat chicken kappo on a third floor in Kitashinchi, open since 2018, built around Nara's Yamato Nikudori chicken and Yamato Gamo duck with sake from Nara. The ¥9,800 seasonal course goes well beyond skewers: chicken sashimi, a chicken-and-uni hand roll, chawanmushi rich with chicken broth, soba and clay-pot rice; a Saturday-only yakitori course is ¥6,600, and à la carte works too. Diners single out the clay-pot rice (you can take the rest home), the oyakodon and the grilled cabbage skewers. Calm counter, private rooms for business dinners; 3% service; no minors.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): chicken kaiseki featuring local Yamato Nikudori chicken and Yamato Gamo duck, with sake from Nara, "the birthplace of sake"; the master chef's skill; a calm, high-quality space. Opened October 29, 2018.
chef_bio.philosophy: Bringing out the appeal of Yamato chicken (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "This place is more than just a yakitori restaurant; it truly embodies the essence of a chicken kappou, as the name suggests." — June 2026.
"the grilled cabbage skewers were so good that we ordered them twice! We were also able to take home the clay pot rice as a souvenir" — June 2026.
"I was pleasantly surprised by the soba, which had a wonderful aroma and taste." — July 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Attentive staff; counter and private rooms (2026). No English evidence found.

staff_allergy_handling: Asks guests to write allergies or dislikes in the booking request (Tabelog).

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_okihama_soba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Okinawa soba noodles are wheat, shipped from Okinawa (Tabelog).
osaka_okihama_soba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito and kombu broth (pork bone too, per a May 2026 diner), pork toppings.
osaka_okihama_soba.hours_raw: Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat 11:30–14:00; Tue and Wed 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–20:30; closed Sundays and holidays; irregular closures posted on Instagram (Tabelog). No reservations; queue outside at lunch until called (2026 reviews). Jushi can sell out after 13:00 (May 2026). Opened September 28, 2012 (Tabelog). Cash or PayPay; no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: 7 at the counter and two tables for 4–6; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog).
osaka_okihama_soba.notes: [Ramen · Fukushima, Okinawa soba tucked in an apartment block] A sixteen-seat Okinawa soba shop at the back of an apartment building's ground floor in Fukushima, open since 2012, that an Okinawan friend sent one diner to for the soki soba. The broth is light kombu and bonito, the noodles come from Okinawa, and the soki spare ribs and sanmai belly are braised until they melt; mozuku, aasa seaweed and Spam-and-egg bowls too, from about ¥1,000. Order jushi, the Okinawan mixed rice, before it sells out after one. Expect a short queue at lunch; dinner only Tuesday and Wednesday. Cash or PayPay; sanpin tea poured.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): an authentic Okinawa soba specialty shop in Fukushima; classic sanmai niku soba and soki soba, plus pota-tama soba and Okinawa-produced aasa soba; broth of kombu and katsuobushi with long-simmered pork, and noodles shipped directly from Okinawa. Opened September 28, 2012.

anecdotes.text: "The spare ribs in the Soki Soba were so tender that I wondered if they had any cartilage left." — June 2026.
"The Jushi was even better than what I had previously eaten in Okinawa." — May 2026.
"The noodles had a light flavor with a gentle aroma of dashi (broth)." — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Wait outside until called; quick service (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_koya_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses have included gougères, a corned-beef sandwich, a venison cutlet, a tart and pasta; tell the shop your preferences (Tabelog).
osaka_koya_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of foie gras, caviar, seafood and Omi beef.
osaka_koya_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Short courses from 20:30 (Tabelog). Cancellations for parties of 3 or more at least three days ahead (Tabelog). Drinks are wine and beer only (September 2026). Opened March 3, 2002 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 seats at an L-shaped counter; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2026). Tabelog French WEST 100 in 2023 and 2025.
osaka_koya_kitashinchi.notes: [French · Kitashinchi, an eight-seat wine-bar counter] An eight-seat L-shaped counter on a third floor in Kitashinchi, running since 2002 and on Tabelog's French WEST 100, that calls itself a wine bar but serves an omakase of creative French dishes with Japanese touches: corned beef from Okazaki Farm, caviar-topped rice, foie gras in unexpected pairings, and sirloin from cattle fed for 49 months. About ten dishes cost ¥19,800, a later short course ¥15,400, and the drinks are wine and beer only, with regulars opening grand Bordeaux. Diners love the owner's easy explanations and the relaxed counter; one found the food over-intricate and the room hot in May.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a hidden gem for adults near Kitashinchi Station; creative French courses that highlight natural flavours with simple yet refined dishes; the chef's special course of long-fed Omi beef; an extensive wine list; a relaxed, homey atmosphere with a comfortable distance from the owner. Opened March 3, 2002. The official site calls it a wine bar in Kitashinchi.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase with Okazaki Farm Omi beef; wine.

anecdotes.text: "It's perfectly fine whether you talk to other guests or not—there's absolutely no discomfort." — August 2023.
"Although it is a top-tier French restaurant, the atmosphere is relaxed, featuring only counter seating that makes it feel welcoming." — September 2026.
"The creative French dishes felt a bit too experimental." — May 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter with each dish explained (2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through October 2026.
